result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would aim to improve global access to quality education. Education is a powerful tool that can help reduce poverty, improve health and well-being, and foster peace and stability. By ensuring that everyone has access to education, we can empower individuals and communities to reach their full potential, while contributing to a more just and equitable world. This includes not only formal education, but also access to lifelong learning opportunities and resources for self-directed learning.
